entry.title: Never start a media sync after the full download
entry.content:
Never start a media sync after the full download

Passing server_usn to full_upload_or_download makes the backend sync the whole
media folder in the background. On Cloud Run that fills the in-memory /tmp at
~100 MB/min until the instance is killed, which is what the 'memory limit
exceeded' restarts were. Card images come from MediaStore per file instead.

entry.title: Python server on the official anki library with AnkiWeb sync and card…
entry.content:
Python server on the official anki library with AnkiWeb sync and card images

Replaces the Go/AnkiWeb-private-API prototype (kept on branch go-ankiweb) with a
single Python FastMCP server: disposable collection copy synced with AnkiWeb
(lag of one, download-only on full sync), real scheduler queue, grade, bury,
session skip, undo. Card images are fetched per file through the media sync
downloadFiles call, downscaled, cached, and attached to tool results so the
agent can see them. Single-user OAuth 2.1 for claude.ai, Cloud Run deploy script.
